title: A walk that closes a recording and opens one again runs to the end
goal: The probe app the loop tests with dies the moment a walk closes a recording and opens one again, so no walk can check anything that happens after a recording is reopened. The crash is in the test harness's own timing meter, which the shipping app does not include.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-29 on main at 8e594bb1 (source edits stashed, probe rebuilt) and again with them: /tmp/ptl/close-reopen-walk.json = setup {timelineOpen:true, forget:[all]}; steps openSampleRecording, wait 2, videoPause, wait 0.5, closeDocument, openSampleRecording, wait 2, snapshot. `Scripts/playtest.sh /tmp/ptl/close-reopen-walk.json` -> 'Verdict: CRASHED EXC_BAD_ACCESS (SIGSEGV) in closure #1 in MainThreadMeter.install() < static PhotonzApp.$main()'. Top frames: swift_getObjectType < swift_task_isMainExecutorImpl < SerialExecutorRef::isMainExecutor < swift_task_isCurrentExecutorWithFlagsImpl < closure #1 in MainThreadMeter.install() < CFRunLoopObserver callout < -[NSApplication run]. So it is the executor-isolation check Swift inserts at the top of the run loop observer's closure (PlaytestHarness.swift, MainThreadMeter.install, [unowned self] on a never-freed singleton), reading a bad executor pointer after closeDocument. Reports: ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports/Photonz Probe-2026-09-29-0418*.ips. Likely fix: make the observer body nonisolated (MainActor.assumeIsolated or plain nonisolated state) so no executor check runs from a CF callout, then find what closeDocument leaves dangling. Found by the timeline-dock-resize task, whose walk dropped its close/reopen step because of this. Checked: a-video-window-says-its-name-walk (closes a recording, then opens a PNG) passes, so closing alone is not enough; it is reopening a recording after the close.
acceptance: A walk that opens the sample recording, closes it and opens it again finishes with status ok
timeline-dock-resizes-walk gets its close-and-reopen step back (it checks the dragged timeline height is remembered) and passes
The fix says whether the shipping app can hit the same crash, and if so fixes it there too
